environment.note: One experiment browser/page/context at a time. Other OS activity is uncontrolled; load average is context, not this Worklet CPU utilization.

measurement.rounding: Round each interval up independently to complete 128-frame producer blocks.

ordinaryBaseline.boundaryMethod: Approximate main-thread wall waits with RPC bookends after Play; record actual producer position and main-thread monotonic times at every boundary.
ordinaryBaseline.interpretation: Untimed progress control only. Its RPC boundaries do not identify the same logical PCM or processing-cost window as the three instrumented modes.

measurement.ordinaryTiming: Unmodified product processor. No per-block elapsed metrics or full PCM scan: unavailable is not zero.

captureScan.scope: Every emitted stereo frame during warmup plus the measured window; scalar finite/stereo/RMS/peak aggregates only.
captureScan.distinction: Scan aggregates cover 264704 frames, while render/total timing histograms cover only the 220544-frame measured window. Ordinary, timed and quiet-ui do not compute full PCM aggregates.

measurement.interpretation: Wall-clock render spans include scheduling. Date.now quantization is reported, not interpreted as an audible underrun. Audio currentTime/currentFrame are logical progress, not elapsed CPU time.

interpretation.ordinary: Production processor bytes unchanged: no per-block timer, counters or PCM scan. Processing-time metrics are unavailable.
interpretation.timing: Instrumented producer process() wall span includes renderInto and stereo copy, not pure WASM or CPU time; total adds the old-style PCM scan. Aggregate updates and boundary state reads are outside the timer.
interpretation.clocks: AudioContext.currentTime/currentFrame are logical progress, never render-duration clocks. Date.now is non-monotonic. The same nominal 1ms quantization allowance is used for observed clocks as a declared assumption, not a measured error guarantee.
interpretation.windows: Only instrumented modes pre-arm an identical producer-frame window. Ordinary mode remains a distinct approximate wall-duration progress baseline, with actual IPC bookend positions recorded; it has no measured producer-cost or full-PCM window.
interpretation.outcome: Timing threshold counts, context progress and sparse analyser samples do not establish actual device underruns, audible glitches, whole-song compatibility or long-term stability.

interpretation.beyondQuantumOverBudgetBlocks: Conditional wall-span classification after subtracting quantumMs; not confirmed device underruns.
interpretation.quantiles: Nearest-rank histogram intervals; upperMs is exclusive, and null for overflow. No interpolation.
interpretation.observerUpdate: record() aggregate updates and snapshot() are outside the timed spans.
